title: CaptureRecipe
description: Formal written contract and schema for Greenshot DAG-based capture recipes and recipe extensions ("kind": "extension").

$schema.description: Optional URI referencing this schema for editor autocompletion and validation.

kind.description: A recipe (with triggers) or an extension: a small flow Greenshot puts into a slot of other recipes (with extends, no triggers).

version.description: Recipe format version. Greenshot reads 2.x; recipes of an earlier beta (1.x) are not read.

id.description: Unique identifier of the recipe. Matching a built-in ID (e.g. 'recipe_region') overrides that built-in recipe.

name.description: Human-readable display name for the recipe.

description.description: Optional description of what this recipe accomplishes.

authors.description: Who wrote the recipe; shown when it is approved. Kept in the file so the credit travels with it.

name.description: The name as the author wants to be credited.

github.description: The GitHub login of the author.

copyright.description: The copyright notice, e.g. 'Copyright (c) 2026 Jane Doe', which the license may require to stay with every copy.

license.description: The license of the file as an SPDX identifier, e.g. 'MIT'.

translations.description: The texts of the file in other languages, by language ('de' or 'de-DE') and then by path. Greenshot uses the exact language, else the language alone, else the texts of the file.

showInContextMenu.description: A recipe without a ContextMenu trigger gets an entry in Greenshot's system tray menu; false leaves it out.

requires.description: Optional list of extension or plugin dependencies required to execute this recipe.

triggers.description: Optional modular triggers attached to this recipe (e.g. Hotkey, ContextMenu for Greenshot's system tray menu, Clipboard).

nodes.description: Flow-local modular execution nodes configured with unique IDs and step parameters.

flow.description: DAG workflow definition configuring entry points, transitions, conditional branches, and join merges.

options.description: Values the user sets once in Settings > Recipes (switches also in the quick settings), read by nodes with ${option.key}. The values are stored in greenshot.ini, not in the recipe file.

extends.description: Extensions only: which recipes it extends, at which slot and in which order.

recipes.description: Recipe ids, "*" (every recipe with the slot) or "*capture" (recipes with a Source step and a destination). AI tool recipes are only extended when named by id.

slot.description: Where the extension goes: a Slot node of the recipe with this name. BeforeDestination runs in the export steps, once per destination on its own copy of the capture.

order.description: Several extensions on one slot run by order, then by id.

when.description: Extensions only: an expression evaluated at the slot, e.g. "${payload.width > 800}"; when false the extension is skipped for that run.

concurrency.description: What happens when the recipe is started while a flow of it is still running: run both (Parallel), ignore the new start (Exclusive) or cancel the running flow (ReplacePrevious).

RecipeOption.description: An option of the recipe, shown in Settings > Recipes.

key.description: Unique in the recipe, used as ${option.key}.

default.description: The value until the user changes it. A Color is "#RRGGBB" or "#AARRGGBB", a Hotkey like "Ctrl + Shift + D" (empty: no hotkey), a DirectoryPath a full path, %VARIABLES% allowed.

label.description: The text in the settings, the key when empty.

choices.description: The values of an Enum option.

label.description: The text in the settings, the value when empty.

enabledWhen.description: The key of a Boolean option: this option can only be changed while that one is on.

quickSettings.description: Also show the option in the quick settings of the tray menu (Boolean and Enum only).

format.description: A hint how a String is meant, e.g. dateTime for a .NET date and time format, or template: ${...} in the value is evaluated where the option is used (e.g. a caption "${now:yyyy-MM-dd}").

startNodes.description: Starting node IDs for workflow entry points.

transitions.description: Every connection between nodes: plain (from, to), a branch of a Conditional node (from, branch, to) or an error route (from, onError, to or recipe).

from.description: Source node ID. For an error route also "*": any node.

branch.description: Branch key on a Conditional node (e.g. 'A', 'B', 'true', 'false').

onError.description: Makes this an error route: the error type it handles, "*" for every error.

recipe.description: Error routes only: a recipe ID to run instead of a node ('to').

id.description: Unique flow-local identifier for this node (referenced by flow transitions).

stepType.description: The modular step type identifier. Supports core built-in steps (Source, InteractiveSelection, Effect, TextEffect, Annotation, SetVariable, ImmediateFeedback, Ocr, Destinations, Notification, Conditional, Slot) as well as extension/plugin-provided steps (e.g., ExternalCommand, Box, Dropbox, Jira, Confluence, Office, BarcodeScan).

name.description: Optional label for this node (defaults to stepType if omitted).

enabled.description: Whether this node runs. A node which doesn't run passes the flow on to its next nodes.

when.description: An expression such as "${option.border}": the node runs only when it is true, otherwise it passes the flow on to its next nodes.

Name.description: Used by 'Slot' step: the name of the slot, where extensions add their steps.

Accept.description: Used by 'Slot' step: the ids of the extensions the slot takes. Left out: all extensions; an empty list: none.

Edges.description: Used by 'Effect' step (TornEdge): the torn edges. Left out: all four.

SourceType.description: Used by 'Source' step: The kind of raw pixels to capture.

Filename.description: Used by 'Source' step (SourceType=File): Path or expression (e.g. '${Filename}') to the image file to load.

Text.description: Used by 'Stdout' step: String template or expression (e.g. '${Barcode.Text}') to emit to stdout.

WindowTitlePattern.description: Used by 'Source' and 'RecordVideo' steps (Window): regular expression (.NET syntax) the window title must contain a match for. For a literal title escape characters such as ( ) . [ ] with a backslash, e.g. 'Report \(draft\)'. Anchor with ^ and $ for the whole title.

ProcessName.description: Used by 'Source' step (Window/ActiveWindow): Target process name (e.g. 'notepad', 'Greenshot').

WindowHandle.description: Used by 'Source' step (Window): the window to capture without asking or activating it, usually the variable of a Window argument (e.g. '${Window}').

MatchCase.description: Whether WindowTitlePattern and ProcessName match case-sensitively.

CaptureMouseCursor.description: Used by 'Source' step: Explicitly pre-defines mouse capture. If omitted, dynamically evaluates CoreConfig.CaptureMousepointer.

DelayMs.description: Used by 'Source' step: Pre-capture delay in milliseconds.

SelectionMode.description: Used by 'InteractiveSelection' step: The UI selection overlay mode.

AllowWindowSnapping.description: Used by 'InteractiveSelection' step: Whether to snap selection rect to windows under the cursor.

Width.description: Used by 'Effect' step: border width (Border) or new width (Resize, instead of Percentage).

Height.description: Used by 'Effect' step (Resize): new height, instead of Percentage.

Color.description: Used by 'Effect' step (Border): the border color (e.g. '#FF0000', 'Blue', 'rgba(255,0,0,128)').

BackgroundColor.description: Used by 'Effect' step (ResizeCanvas, RemoveTransparency): the color of the added canvas or of the removed transparency.

Percentage.description: Used by 'Effect' step (Resize): the new size in percent. Use either Percentage or Width/Height, not both.

Left.description: Used by 'Effect' step (ResizeCanvas): pixels added on the left.

Top.description: Used by 'Effect' step (ResizeCanvas): pixels added at the top.

Right.description: Used by 'Effect' step (ResizeCanvas): pixels added on the right.

Bottom.description: Used by 'Effect' step (ResizeCanvas): pixels added at the bottom.

Effect.description: Used by 'Effect' step: The effect type to apply.

Annotations.description: Used by 'Annotation' step: List of annotation elements to place on the capture surface.

Variables.description: Used by 'SetVariable' step: the variables to set, name to value (an expression or a literal).

DestinationDesignations.description: Used by 'Destinations' step: Explicit list of destination designations (e.g. ['Clipboard', 'FileNoDialog', 'Editor']).

PlaySound.description: Used by 'ImmediateFeedback' step: Explicitly pre-defines shutter sound.

Branches.description: Used by 'Conditional' step: List of decision branches evaluating expressions.

UntilWindowCloses.description: Used by 'RecordVideo' step: Automatically stops recording when target window is closed.

DurationSeconds.description: Used by 'RecordVideo' step: Maximum recording duration in seconds (0 = unlimited / until stopped or window closed).

OutputDirectory.description: Used by 'RecordVideo' step: the directory for the video, supports %VAR% expansion. Without it the video goes to the Videos folder.

FilenamePattern.description: Used by 'RecordVideo' step: the file name in OutputDirectory, {yyyyMMdd_HHmmss} is the start time (default 'Greenshot_{yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.mp4').

Preset.description: Used by 'RecordVideo' step: Pre-configured quality and framerate preset.

Format.description: Used by 'RecordVideo' step: Video codec container format.

FrameRate.description: Used by 'RecordVideo' step: Target recording frames per second (e.g. 15, 30, 60, 144).

Bitrate.description: Used by 'RecordVideo' step: Target video bitrate in bits per second (e.g. 2500000).

TargetWidth.description: Used by 'RecordVideo' step: Downscaled/upscaled video width in pixels.

TargetHeight.description: Used by 'RecordVideo' step: Downscaled/upscaled video height in pixels.

ScaleFactor.description: Used by 'RecordVideo' step: Uniform scaling factor applied to frames (e.g. 0.5, 0.75).

ColorMode.description: Used by 'RecordVideo' step: Color mode for recorded frames.

ShowCaptureBorder.description: Used by 'RecordVideo' step: Displays OS yellow capture border during recording (Windows 11+).

WindowResizeBehavior.description: Used by 'RecordVideo' step: How canvas handles target window size changes.

AudioSource.description: Used by 'RecordVideo' step: Audio source recorded alongside video track.

PreventSleepWhileRecording.description: Used by 'RecordVideo' step: Prevents system idle sleep while recording.

AutoPauseOnSessionLock.description: Used by 'RecordVideo' step: Pauses recording automatically when workstation is locked.

Expression.description: Dynamic expression (${...}) or 'else' evaluated at runtime.

Type.description: The type of annotation element. Built-in types include Rectangle, Ellipse, Line, Arrow, Freehand, Text, Speechbubble, StepLabel, Image, Icon, Cursor, Emoji, Blur, Pixelize, Highlight, Magnify, Crop. Extension-provided annotations (e.g. QRCode, Barcode) are dynamically registered by installed plugins.

HorizontalAnchor.description: Horizontal alignment anchor relative to the capture payload surface.

VerticalAnchor.description: Vertical alignment anchor relative to the capture payload surface.

Left.description: Distance from the left edge, or expression (e.g. 20, '${payload.width - 200}').

Top.description: Distance from the top edge, or expression (e.g. 15, '${payload.height - 50}').

Right.description: Distance from the right edge, or expression.

Bottom.description: Distance from the bottom edge, or expression.

Text.description: Text content for Text, Speechbubble, or StepLabel (supports string interpolation like 'User: ${user.username} on ${machine.computername} at ${now:yyyy-MM-dd}').

TextAlign.description: Horizontal alignment of the text inside the element.

Shadow.description: Whether to render a drop shadow for the element.

FilePath.description: File path for Image (bitmap or SVG), Icon or Cursor annotations; instead of ImageData.

ImageData.description: The file contents (PNG, JPEG, SVG, cursor, ...) Base64 encoded, for Image or Cursor annotations; instead of FilePath.

CursorName.description: Standard Windows cursor preset name for Cursor annotations.

HotspotX.description: Horizontal hotspot coordinate offset in pixels for Cursor annotations.

HotspotY.description: Vertical hotspot coordinate offset in pixels for Cursor annotations.

LockAspectRatio.description: Whether to preserve the width-to-height aspect ratio when resizing or configuring the annotation.

ArrowHeads.description: Arrowheads rendering placement for Arrow annotations.

Number.description: Counter sequence number for StepLabel annotations.

BlurRadius.description: Blur kernel radius in pixels for Blur annotations.

PixelSize.description: Pixel block size in pixels for Pixelize annotations.

MagnificationFactor.description: Magnification zoom multiplier (e.g. 2 for 2x zoom) for Magnify annotations.

ForeColor.description: Foreground or module color for QRCode or Barcode annotations.

BackColor.description: Background quiet-zone color for QRCode or Barcode annotations.

RoundedDots.description: Whether QRCode data modules are drawn as rounded dots instead of square blocks.

TailDirection.description: Direction/placement preset of the tail for Speechbubble annotations.

TailOffsetX.description: Horizontal pixel offset for Speechbubble tail.

TailOffsetY.description: Vertical pixel offset for Speechbubble tail.

TailX.description: Absolute X coordinate of the Speechbubble tail target.

TailY.description: Absolute Y coordinate of the Speechbubble tail target.

Size.description: Square size dimension (e.g. for icon, emoji, or square element).

Margin.description: Distance from the edge of the capture when anchored, in pixels.

QuietZone.description: QRCode and Barcode: the empty border around the code, in modules.

id.description: Unique identifier of the required extension or plugin (e.g. 'Greenshot.Plugin.Zxing').

name.description: Optional human-readable display name of the required extension.

minVersion.description: Optional minimum version required for the extension (e.g. '1.3.0').

url.description: Optional download or documentation URL where the extension can be obtained.

name.description: Optional human-readable label for this trigger.

enabled.description: Whether this trigger is currently active.

when.description: Optional expression: the trigger is only registered while it is true, e.g. "${option.useHotkey}" or "${config.CaptureWindowsInteractive}". Checked when the triggers are registered (start, settings or options changed).

Hotkey.description: Key combination (e.g. 'Ctrl + Shift + B', 'Alt + PrintScreen'), '${option.key}' for the value of a Hotkey option the user sets in the settings, or '${config.Name}' for a hotkey of the general settings (e.g. '${config.RegionHotkey}', as the built-in recipes do). Required for Hotkey triggers.

MenuItemText.description: Custom label displayed in the Greenshot system tray context menu (ContextMenu trigger) or the image editor menu (Editor trigger).

Group.description: Submenu group in the Greenshot system tray context menu (ContextMenu trigger) or image editor menu (Editor trigger). The default or empty 'Recipes' group is shown directly and first; named groups are submenus sorted alphabetically.

Order.description: Sort order within the menu group; recipe name breaks ties.

OnImageCopied.description: For clipboard trigger: whether to trigger automatically when an image is copied to clipboard.

Command.description: Used by Commandline trigger: Command name / verb invoked from CLI (e.g. 'qr', 'convert', 'ocr').

Description.description: Human-readable description displayed in CLI recipe listings.

FireAndForget.description: Whether the trigger runs asynchronously without blocking the caller.

AllowBrowserInvocation.description: Used by Commandline trigger: allows this recipe to be started from a browser, via a greenshot:// URL or the browser extension. Off by default because any web page can open a greenshot:// URL.

Stdout.description: Used by Commandline trigger: Expression or string template (e.g. '${Barcode.Text}') evaluated and emitted to stdout upon completion.

ToolName.description: Used by AiTool trigger: the tool name AI tools use (greenshot-mcp).

Title.description: Used by AiTool trigger: the name of the tool shown to people.

ReadOnly.description: Used by AiTool trigger: hint that the tool doesn't change anything (e.g. only captures).

Destructive.description: Used by AiTool trigger: hint that the tool can overwrite or delete something.

MaxImageSize.description: Used by AiTool trigger: the image returned to the AI tool is scaled so its longest side is at most this many pixels, 0 keeps the original size.

Arguments.description: Explicit list of named arguments accepted from the command line (Commandline trigger) or the AI tool (AiTool trigger), their target context variables, requirement, and default values.

name.description: CLI argument name passed by user (e.g. 'file', 'format', 'lang').

variable.description: Target flow context variable (e.g. 'Filename', 'Format'). Defaults to name if omitted.

description.description: Explanation of this argument displayed in CLI listings.

required.description: Whether this argument is mandatory. Execution fails if not provided and no default exists.

defaultValue.description: Default value applied when the argument is omitted by the user.

type.description: Type of the value. FilePath/DirectoryPath values are sanitized and resolved against the caller's working directory; Integer, Decimal and Boolean values are parsed; Enum values must be one of allowedValues. Window (AiTool triggers only): a window id from list_windows, resolved to the window. Region: 'x,y,width,height' in screen coordinates. Only declared arguments are accepted by a recipe.

allowedValues.description: Accepted values (required for type Enum, optional restriction for String).
